scope: Editorial audit of selected published units; not full curriculum certification

rows.subject: Bahasa Melayu
rows.title: Dengar dan Kenal Benda
rows.reviewNotes: Four short object-name/use teaching frames align with six picture questions. Correct choices match teaching; actual audio availability/voice quality remains separate runtime verification.

rows.subject: English
rows.title: Listen and Find a Colour
rows.reviewNotes: Four colours are explicitly modelled then matched, including transfer to book/cup. Colour matching alone needs an alternative for colour-vision difficulties; no answer-key defect found.

rows.subject: Matematik
rows.title: Kira Bersama
rows.reviewNotes: Counting and combining/taking one taught with <=5 visible source objects. Correct cardinalities recomputed; number choices pictorially represent counts, including abstract transfer from books/fish to balls.

rows.subject: Sains
rows.title: Lihat dengan Mata
rows.reviewNotes: Eyes/ears and observable colours taught before matched picture questions. One selected sensory unit is not a complete D1 science course.

rows.subject: Pendidikan Islam
rows.title: Syukur dan Jaga Makanan
rows.correction: Label tindakan yang tidak sepadan dengan gambar blok/pinggan diganti. Ikon bantuan dan penghargaan masih memerlukan ujian kefahaman kanak-kanak.

findings.evidence: practice q4 option “Tinggalkan makanan untuk bermain” uses blocks; q3 “Buang pinggan” uses bin whose aria label is “Buang makanan yang masih elok”.
findings.issue: Some pre-reader picture options depict a different object/action from the accompanying spoken text; reusable symbols do not demonstrate the actual action.
findings.recommendation: Use accurately matched picture/action labels and scenes; at minimum remove mismatched options. Show asking an adult and thanking through an understandable taught scene, not just a question-mark icon.

rows.reviewNotes: Food care and thanks are taught before short questions; subject coverage remains selected adab only, not full Pendidikan Islam. Visual mismatch findings are concrete.

rows.subject: Pendidikan Moral
rows.title: Main, Kongsi dan Simpan
rows.correction: Bulan tidak lagi dilabel menyembunyikan mainan; gambar pinggan tidak lagi dilabel makanan di lantai. Adegan sosial masih perlu penambahbaikan visual.

findings.evidence: practice q3 “Sorok daripada rakan” maps to sleep (Moon); “Ambil tanpa izin” maps to blocks; practice q4 “Letak makanan di lantai” maps to a clean plated meal.
findings.issue: The visual evidence cannot tell a pre-reader which depicted action corresponds to the option. This undermines the stated non-reading path.
findings.recommendation: Replace mismatched distractor scenes or labels; teach the help/share action through an explicit scene. Keep picture, visible text, spoken text and aria label semantically consistent.

rows.reviewNotes: Turn-taking, storage and asking teacher taught before short questions; several reused distractor pictures are semantically wrong.

rows.subject: Bahasa Melayu
rows.title: Ikut Arahan Mengikut Giliran
rows.reviewNotes: Ordered instruction passage and independent card-making practice align; explicit sequencing cues and retrieval. Suitable for a reader with short-sentence support, not proof all D2 pupils can read it independently.

rows.subject: English
rows.title: Every Day or Right Now?
rows.reviewNotes: Routine versus current action correctly distinguished; is/are and -ing teaching matches questions. Vocabulary such as costume/scarves/ribbon needs optional picture/glossary support for emerging English readers.

rows.subject: Matematik
rows.title: Puluh, Sa dan Kumpul Semula
rows.correction: Tambah contoh menolak puluh penuh 42 − 20 = 22 sebelum latihan.

findings.evidence: Note teaches 27 + 15 and place value; practice q4 asks 72 − 20.
findings.issue: A new subtraction operation is assessed without a worked subtraction or prerequisite check in this unit.
findings.recommendation: Add a short tens subtraction example with bundles/pictures before practice, or mark this question as prerequisite-dependent and gate it.

rows.reviewNotes: Regrouping and tens/ones arithmetic correct; addition supplements mapped explicitly are within this concept. Subtraction appears before a worked subtraction example.

rows.subject: Sains
rows.title: Benih Mula Bercambah
rows.reviewNotes: Germination, air/water and fair comparison are internally sound; isolate same seed/location with wet/dry cotton. Long comparison choices may need reading support, not a proven grade error.

rows.subject: Pendidikan Islam
rows.title: Kata Baik Ketika Berbeza Pendapat
rows.reviewNotes: Good speech/listening note, story and scenario align; actual assessed skill mostly everyday adab/read comprehension. No full Quran/Jawi/ibadah syllabus claim supported.

rows.subject: Pendidikan Moral
rows.title: Mendengar Sebelum Membantu
rows.reviewNotes: Listening before assuming emotion and limited requested help consistently taught and tested; familiar child context.

rows.subject: Bahasa Melayu
rows.title: Bezakan Sebab dengan Tujuan
rows.reviewNotes: Cause/purpose and limits of inference are taught then assessed consistently. No answer-key error found.

rows.subject: English
rows.title: Put Yesterday’s Events in Order
rows.correction: Tambah pasangan draw → drew dan contoh ayat sebelum latihan.

findings.evidence: Teaching examples painted/made; practice q2 requires drew as past form of draw.
findings.issue: The irregular target verb is introduced only in the answer explanation, despite the teach-before-assessment promise.
findings.recommendation: Add a small draw → drew example or vocabulary pair in the note before the question.

rows.reviewNotes: Sequence and regular/irregular past are correctly explained at a general level. One irregular verb required by practice is absent from teaching.

rows.subject: Matematik
rows.title: Kumpulan Sama Banyak
rows.reviewNotes: Equal grouping, multiplication, equal division and inverse check align; recomputed all six unit answers. Larger mapped multiplications are extensions of same method.

rows.subject: Sains
rows.title: Bahan yang Menyerap Air
rows.reviewNotes: Absorbency dataset and fair-test conclusions sound. Grade provenance requires resolution: current PPD Batu Pahat teaching portal lists absorption Year1, density/acids Year3; an old EduwebTV search lists Year3 absorption. Treat as possible legacy-curriculum placement or prerequisite practice, not verified D3 core mapping. Source https://sites.google.com/moe-dl.edu.my/ppd-batu-pahat-sains-matematik/kemenjadian-murid/sekolah-rendah/sains-sekolah-rendah .

rows.reviewNotes: di location versus passive di- is taught correctly; questions combine taught spelling discrimination and passage retrieval.

rows.subject: English

rows.correction: Rujukan soalan terakhir dibuang; setiap soalan menyatakan kuantiti yang dikehendaki.

findings.evidence: Practice context says Soalan terakhir merujuk harga buku sahaja.
findings.issue: Root review found an order-dependent reference in a bank whose questions can be selected and reordered.

rows.subject: Matematik
rows.title: Peratus daripada Kuantiti
rows.correction: Tambah kaedah bahagian ÷ jumlah × 100% dengan contoh 18/60 = 30%.

findings.evidence: Note teaches percent/100 × quantity. Practice q3 asks “Berapakah peratus buku yang telah dipinjam?” with 45 of120 →37.5%.
findings.issue: Quantity-to-percentage is a different direction from all worked teaching examples; the procedure first appears after answering.
findings.recommendation: Teach part ÷ whole ×100 with a different worked quantity and explain a decimal percentage before this task.

rows.reviewNotes: All arithmetic is correct, but the inverse percentage task is not taught in note/read passage.

rows.subject: Sains

rows.correction: Tambah contoh jarak = laju tetap × masa dan laju purata yang merangkumi berhenti.

findings.evidence: Note works only 12 m ÷4 s=3 m/s. Practice q3 requires2 m/s×7 s and q4 includes5 s stopped.
findings.issue: Distance from speed/time and inclusion of stop time have no worked example before practice.
findings.recommendation: Add a short repeated-distance example and a worked whole-journey average including a stop, or make them guided teaching items.

rows.reviewNotes: Speed comparisons and calculated answers correct. Two practice methods lack explicit worked teaching before assessment.

rows.subject: English
rows.title: Three Layers of a Past Scene

findings.evidence: Single note introduces past simple, past continuous and past perfect together; practice requires were fastening and had measured. No explicit formation table or preliminary simple/continuous mastery activity exists.
findings.issue: Three-tense cognitive jump for entry secondary learners; no evidence the third tense is suitable as the compulsory first T1 unit.
findings.recommendation: Make T1 core sequence past simple then was/were + -ing with timeline and worked examples; place past perfect in optional extension until grade mapping and prerequisites are verified.

rows.subject: Bahasa Melayu
rows.title: Uji Had Dakwaan dan Arah Syarat

findings.evidence: Practice Q1 options: ["Kelab itu telah diberi tapak paling besar.", "Permohonannya sedang dinilai.", "Kelab itu tidak boleh memohon lagi.", "Cadangannya telah ditolak."]
findings.issue: Upper-secondary reasoning is assessed using mostly blatant contradictions/irrelevant choices; a learner can often eliminate distractors without performing the intended synthesis or inference.
findings.recommendation: Replace implausible distractors with plausible partial summaries, attribution swaps or overgeneralizations while preserving one defensible key. Add scaffolded short justification later; do not equate this six-item MCQ set with exam readiness.

rows.subject: Sains
rows.title: Inersia, Daya Paduan dan Pecutan

findings.evidence: Note teaches F=ma/net force; reading and practice 1–2 depend on it. Teacher-authored DELIMa https://sites.google.com/moe-dl.edu.my/cikguhasyyati/sains-t4/bab-11-t4 lists general Sains T4 11.1 linear motion, 11.2 graphs, 11.3 gravity, 11.4 mass/inertia; Newton-II calculation standard not listed.
findings.issue: Probable subject/grade scope drift: general Sains default is dominated by Physics-style F=ma instead of confirmed general Science motion/inertia content.
findings.recommendation: Use speed/velocity/acceleration from change over time and qualitative mass–inertia examples in general Science; move net-force calculation to explicitly mapped Physics/enrichment after formal DSKP verification.

findings.issue: Upper-secondary reasoning is assessed using mostly blatant contradictions/irrelevant choices; a learner can often eliminate distractors without performing the intended synthesis or inference.
findings.recommendation: Replace implausible distractors with plausible partial summaries, attribution swaps or overgeneralizations while preserving one defensible key. Add scaffolded short justification later; do not equate this six-item MCQ set with exam readiness.
